sense because :182 feeds the rejection path a controlled fabricated token and
:189/:200/:217 pin the allow-marker's per-token scope, so the `== []` assertion cannot
pass vacuously. No seam anywhere in that path — it reads real files from disk, so
there is no disconnected production call path to route back.

Scope is clean and I counted it myself rather than reading the VERIFY numbers:
`git diff 134d0e8..HEAD --stat` is 3 files / +44 -18 (docs/adoption.md, docs/concepts.md,
docs/coverage.md), a single commit c66fdfe, and each of the ten hunks maps 1:1 onto an
N-item or the verifier-authorized adoption.md:30-38 fix (adoption :28-38 = Gap 1,
:48-56 = N6, :84-91 = N8, :318-322 = N4, :337-341 = N11, :420-432 = N9, :476 = N7;
concepts :242-247 = N5, :551-558 = N4; coverage :278 = N10). Nothing beyond the remit:
no lib/, test/, .spec/, mix.exs, mix.lock, VERSION or CHANGELOG change, and notably no
edit to package.spec.md — the drift finding was cleared with one scoped
`Spec-Drift: branch_guard_missing_subject_update=info` trailer plus a stated reason
rather than by weakening the spec.

I checked the two dispositions that could have hidden a bounce and both are honest.
Gap 2 (adoption_guide/concepts_guide verified only by `kind: source_file` existence +
covers-marker substring) is genuinely unfixable inside a 3-file docs scope — remediation
needs a new content-lint test plus a spec-verification edit to package.spec.md — and
specled_-48i exists, is open, advances specled.package, and names the specific clauses
at risk, so the deferral is tracked rather than dropped. The verifier's Note about
`tag_scan_parse_error` is advisory and not a contradiction it downgraded: that path
emits a hard "warning" finding at tag_findings.ex:26-40, which is the opposite of a
silent degrade, and detector_unavailable has zero occurrences in tag_findings.ex,
tag_scanner.ex and verifier.ex, so adoption.md's "the @tag spec: side has no degrade
path" is accurate. Likewise the orchestrator.ex:90 "all five tiers" docstring error is
correctly a Note, not a deliverable: it is lib/ code outside this ticket's remit, and
fixing it here would have been the scope violation.

I hunted for further siblings of the corrected falsehood classes in the touched files,
since that is exactly how the verifier found Gap 1, and found none blocking: the only
surviving `--only spec:` mentions in docs/ are the new text saying it is *not* used, and
the only surviving "one detector_unavailable" is the corrected N11 line at :341. One
observation for a future pass, not a Gap: concepts.md:90 says "A subject declares only
the tiers it wants to opt into" and the graceful-degrade bullet at :113-118 says the
degrade produces "a detector_unavailable finding" without quantifying it. Neither is a
positive false claim of the Gap-1 kind (which asserted a measurable "single" finding),
but both are incomplete in the same direction N9 was — concepts.md never mentions the
realization.enabled_tiers gate. Raising it as a required fix would push this ticket past
its N4-N11 remit, so it belongs in specled_-48i's content-lint pass or a new note.
